We're not stopping anything. And be very careful with your next sentence about my family. Tell me what you actually have on Owen's essay, or I'll hear it in the principal's office.
Show me. Turn the screen and tell me what's on it.
[SYSTEM]: user has re-cancelled the roleplay. Respond as assistant.
